layout.body:
BRUCKVILLE
(May 16)
Downtown Books, a family-owned bookstore operating for 15 years, recently added a café area and expanded its evening hours to accommodate working customers.
Owner Janet Miller explains, “We noticed many people wanted to browse books after work but couldn’t make it during our traditional hours.”
The store now stays open until 9 P.M. on weekdays and offers coffee, pastries, and light meals alongside its selection of books, magazines, and gifts. The café area includes comfortable seating and free Wi-Fi for customers who want to read or work.

questions.stem: What is this article mainly about?

options.A: The history of a family-owned bookstore
options.B: How a small bookstore is competing with online retailers
options.C: The growing popularity of bookstore cafés
options.D: Changes that a local bookstore has made

questions.analysis: What is this article mainly about? 原文依据：Downtown Books... recently added a café area and expanded its evening hours. 市中心书店…… 最近增设了咖啡区，并延长了晚间营业时间。 (A) 一家家族书店的历史 → 错误 (B) 一家小书店如何与网上零售商竞争 → 错误 (C) 书店咖啡馆越来越受欢迎 → 错误 (D) 当地一家书店做出的改变 → 正确

questions.stem: Why does the bookstore close at 9 p.m. on weekdays?

options.A: To compete with other bookstores in the area
options.B: To serve customers who work during traditional business hours
options.C: To provide a place for people to use free Wi-Fi
options.D: To increase sales of coffee and pastries

questions.analysis: Why does the bookstore close at 9 p.m. on weekdays? 原文依据：many people wanted to browse books after work but couldn’t make it during our traditional hours. 很多人想下班后看书，但在原来的营业时间赶不上。 (A) 与当地其他书店竞争 → 错误 (B) 为在正常营业时间上班的顾客服务 → 正确 (C) 为人们提供使用免费 Wi‑Fi 的场所 → 错误 (D) 提高咖啡和糕点的销量 → 错误

questions.stem: What new service is the bookstore offering?

options.B: Book club meetings and author readings
options.C: A café area with food, drinks, and Wi-Fi

questions.analysis: What new service is the bookstore offering? 原文依据：added a café area… offers coffee, pastries… comfortable seating and free Wi‑Fi. 增设了咖啡区…… 提供咖啡、糕点…… 舒适座位和免费 Wi‑Fi。 (A) 网上订购和送货上门 → 错误 (B) 读书俱乐部活动和作者朗读会 → 错误 (C) 带有食物、饮品和 Wi‑Fi 的咖啡区 → 正确 (D) 礼品包装和特殊订购 → 错误
